name: rockmass_calculator
description: CINF矿山岩体质量分级软件

scripts.setup: node scripts/npm-with-electron-mirrors.js install && node scripts/npm-with-electron-mirrors.js install --prefix frontend
scripts.dist: node scripts/build-frontend.js && node scripts/npm-with-electron-mirrors.js exec -- electron-builder
scripts.dist:win: npm install && python scripts/convert-license-to-gbk.py && node scripts/clean.js && node scripts/build-frontend.js && node scripts/verify-frontend-dist.js && node scripts/clean.js release && node scripts/apply-electron-builder-nsis-patches.js && set CINF_PACK_LOCAL_AI=0&& node scripts/stage-pack-resources.js && set CINF_ELECTRON_BUILDER_CONFIG=electron-builder.win.no-ai.yml&& node scripts/build-win.js
scripts.dist:win:ai: npm install && python scripts/convert-license-to-gbk.py && node scripts/clean.js && node scripts/build-frontend.js && node scripts/verify-frontend-dist.js && node scripts/clean.js release-ai && node scripts/apply-electron-builder-nsis-patches.js && set CINF_PACK_LOCAL_AI=1&& node scripts/stage-pack-resources.js && set CINF_ELECTRON_BUILDER_CONFIG=electron-builder.win.ai.yml&& node scripts/build-win.js
scripts.dist:win:full: set CINF_PACK_LOCAL_AI=0&& npm run build:python && npm run dist:win
scripts.dist:win:ai-full: set CINF_PACK_LOCAL_AI=1&& npm run build:python && npm run dist:win:ai
scripts.dist:win:legacy: npm install && python scripts/convert-license-to-gbk.py && node scripts/clean.js legacy && node scripts/build-frontend.js && node scripts/verify-frontend-dist.js && node scripts/build-win7.js
scripts.dist:win:both: npm run dist:win:full && npm run dist:win:legacy
scripts.dist:mac: node scripts/build-frontend.js && node scripts/verify-frontend-dist.js && node scripts/clean.js release && npx electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:linux: node scripts/build-frontend.js && node scripts/verify-frontend-dist.js && node scripts/clean.js release && npx electron-builder --linux
scripts.pack: node scripts/build-frontend.js && node scripts/verify-frontend-dist.js && npx electron-builder --dir
